signals_info.description: Whether a valid traffic light has been detected and associated with the current path.

time_info.description: Bounded traffic-light association window including the current time.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time from now through the next 1 second, a valid associated traffic light shall be detected.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从当前起至接下来的 1 秒内，应至少有一个时刻检测到有效的关联交通灯。
nl_Paraphrase_en: Within the 1-second window including now, the system shall have a valid traffic-light association at least once.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在包含当前时刻的 1 秒窗口内，系统应至少有一个时刻具备有效的交通灯关联结果。
